items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: The conductor Joe Valenti is a real good friend of mine

ctx.x: Well see how long it takes the strings to hit the downbeat.

The conductor Joe Valenti is a real good friend of mine, and a very good trumpet player and actually now he’s switched and he’s learning to play piano very well. But it will be a nice concert. And he has a few ringers that he brings in from the Hollywood area. The

first men to bolster the thing up. Because local symphonies they usually have a little problem, mainly in the strings. So he said, “I’ve got a really good string section for this.” They’re doing the Beethoven “Eroica” and I don’t know what it is of Mendelssohn, some violin concerto or something. But it will be a nice program.
